summary.headline: Milanese Codices 14–16
summary.text: Catalog entries for Milanese codices 14–16: fragments of John Laurentius Lydus on omens and thunderbolts; a sixteenth-century treatise on natural phenomena from October through April, including eclipses, stars, thunder, lightning, and earthquakes; and a thirteenth-century lunar prophetologion with prognostics for the sick and lunar calculations.
